mapper.select: SELECT 'g:' || group_id AS id, NULL AS parent_id, group_id::text AS code, name, description, NULL AS image, inactive, false AS production_outsource, false AS purchase_outsource, false AS inspection, false AS packing, false AS stock_management, false AS previous_stock_out, false AS final_process, false AS planned_equipment, false AS actual_equipment_required FROM tb_process_group WHERE tenant_id = #{value} UNION ALL SELECT 'p:' || process_id, 'g:' || group_id, process_id::text, name, description, image, inactive, production_outsource, purchase_outsource, inspection, packing, stock_management, previous_stock_out, final_process, planned_equipment, actual_equipment_required FROM tb_process WHERE tenant_id = #{value}
INSERT INTO tb_process_group (tenant_id, name, description, inactive) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{row.name}, #{row.description}, #{row.inactive}) RETURNING group_id

INSERT INTO tb_process (tenant_id, group_id, name, description, image, inactive, production_outsource, purchase_outsource, inspection, packing, stock_management, previous_stock_out, final_process, planned_equipment, actual_equipment_required) SELECT #{tenantId}, group_id, #{row.name}, #{row.description}, #{row.image}, #{row.inactive}, #{row.productionOutsource}, #{row.purchaseOutsource}, #{row.inspection}, #{row.packing}, #{row.stockManagement}, #{row.previousStockOut}, #{row.finalProcess}, #{row.plannedEquipment}, #{row.actualEquipmentRequired} FROM tb_process_group WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND group_id = #{groupId} RETURNING process_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_process SET group_id = #{groupId}, name = #{row.name}, description = #{row.description}, image = #{row.image}, inactive = #{row.inactive}, production_outsource = #{row.productionOutsource}, purchase_outsource = #{row.purchaseOutsource}, inspection = #{row.inspection}, packing = #{row.packing}, stock_management = #{row.stockManagement}, previous_stock_out = #{row.previousStockOut}, final_process = #{row.finalProcess}, planned_equipment = #{row.plannedEquipment}, actual_equipment_required = #{row.actualEquipmentRequired}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND process_id = #{id} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_process_group g WHERE g.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND g.group_id = #{groupId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_process_group g WHERE g.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND g.group_id = #{id} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_process p WHERE p.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND p.group_id = g.group_id)
DELETE FROM tb_process WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND process_id = #{id}
